newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Turnover up, prices mixed at Bucharest bourse.
newsitem.headline: Turnover up, prices mixed at Bucharest bourse.

text.p: Shares traded mixed at the Bucharest bourse on Thursday when turnover rose to 92.04 million lei, almost double the level in the previous session.
Top bourse performer Azomures SA fertiliser maker was again in the limelight, taking more than half of overall turnover. It lost 700 lei, to close at 12,100 lei under strong selling pressure.
"The market was flooded with selling orders. Investors were on stand-by waiting for better prices," one trader said.
Pipe-maker Artrom SA saw its prices losing 100 lei to close at 2,550 lei, amid fairly active trading.
Engineer Neptun SA gained 200 lei to close at 4,100 lei and Foraj Sonde SA drilling company saw its price up 50 lei to close at 5,700 lei.
Traders said they expected most prices to slide further in the coming sessions with selling orders waiting to be matched and investors in a profit-taking mood.

The unofficial VAB Index -- a value-weighted index of all stocks computed by Vanguard SA securities -- was 5.3 percent down from the previous session, closing at 353.3 points. Its base was 1,000 points when it was created last November.
